title: Volta
line: A sports-supplement online store you can click through end to end, with a fictional brand, products and orders.

facts.v: Clickable demo, runs in the browser
29 in the store · 60 in the panel

film.alt: Demo admin panel: «Hoy en tu tienda», then stock with batches and expiry dates, then Promos with the wheel.
film.label: Demo · fictional data

ten.v: A small supplement shop takes orders over WhatsApp, chases changing price lists and has tubs expiring on the shelf.
A store that works out when to reorder, sells lots by expiry date and turns games into coupons, plus a panel showing today's tasks.
A clickable demo on sample data. The production version, with a server, is described in the repo.

how.d: The product sheet works out how long the tub lasts.
The panel lists who runs out this week.
The owner sends a ready-made WhatsApp with a link that fills the bag.
The customer opens the ready bag and uses their Club coupon.

decisions.why: Pricing, stock, payments and missions live outside the components: they are tested on their own and move to the server keeping the same screens.
A single Next.js app that runs in the browser; the repo rules out, in writing, Server Actions, cookies, middleware and ISR.
One demo per prospect by changing a sheet: name, colours and its own storage prefix. A test keeps the brand inside the sheets.

tienda.alt: Dark store with lime accents on a phone: Protein, the Ionic Whey sheet with price per serving, and the bag with the stack discount.
tienda.caption: VOLTA store (Demo): catalogue → product → cart.

club-ruleta.caption: VOLTA club: the "Disco olímpico" wheel spins and gives a coupon.

regalar.alt: Phone screen of VOLTA's gift section: "Regalá energía", tabs for a product, a stack or a gift card, and a creatine tub.
regalar.caption: Gifts: "Regalá energía" with a product, stack or gift card.

more.p: A single function decides which transition is valid and with which trigger. A payment proof reaches Paid only through the panel's approval.
Everything stays in the browser: WhatsApp is a link with ready-made text and a payment proof is processed in a canvas. Forms validated with Zod, gifts with a check digit.
Strict TypeScript and ESLint. CI runs lint, typecheck, unit tests, build and an export check before publishing; 988 unit tests passing on 10/28/2026.

next: Next step: split the panel's data and test on real iPhone and Android phones.
